android.desc: TIRED OF SLOW APP SWITCHING? Stop opening the recents screen every time you need to switch apps. Dsk Mode transforms your navigation bar into a Windows-style taskbar that shows only your truly open apps - just like a desktop OS. WHAT MAKES DSK MODE UNIQUE: • Shows ONLY open apps - Unlike the recents screen which shows your entire app history, Dsk Mode displays only apps currently running in memory • Replaces your navigation bar - No other app can do this! Transform your nav bar into a powerful taskbar • Instant app switching - Tap any app icon to switch immediately, no recents screen needed • Pinned favorites - Keep your most-used apps always accessible • Built-in mini launcher - Quick access to all your apps with smart sorting FREE FEATURES: • Desktop-style taskbar showing up to 3 truly open apps • Pin up to 3 favorite apps for instant access • Toggle between popup mode and sticky mode (replaces nav bar) • Choose gestures or buttons in sticky mode • Mini app launcher with recently installed apps, A-Z and Z-A sorting • Multiple color themes including dynamic theming UPGRADE TO SUPPORT DEV PACK: • Unlimited open apps - See all your running apps at once • Unlimited pinned apps - Pin as many favorites as you want • Full launcher access - Unlock all tabs in the mini app launcher • Ad-free experience - Focus on productivity without interruptions HOW IT WORKS: Dsk Mode transforms your system navigation bar into a desktop-style taskbar. Switch between popup mode (appears when needed) or sticky mode (shows always on your nav bar). Your truly open apps appear as icons, just like Windows or Mac OS taskbars. PERFECT FOR: • Mobile professionals juggling multiple apps • Anyone frustrated with Android's recents screen • Users who want desktop-like multitasking on mobile • Power users who value speed and efficiency ACCESSIBILITY PERMISSION REQUIREMENT To enable Dsk Mode, this app needs accessibility service permission: Accessibility Service Permission: • To show Taskbar over your system navigation • To enable system navigations on the taskbar • Provide quick access to your favorite apps Privacy Note: We don't collect, store, or transmit any personal data. This permission is used solely for Dsk Mode.

quotes.text:
Hey everyone, I have been working on something new for Android users who hate opening the Recents screen for every small app switch. I built an app called Dsk Mode, and it turns your navigation bar into a simple desktop-style taskbar.

What it does
Dsk Mode shows only the apps that are actually open and running, not your entire app history. You can tap any icon to switch instantly. You can also pin favorite apps and open a mini launcher for quick access.

There are two modes depending on how you want to use it:
• Popup Mode, where the taskbar appears only when needed
• Sticky Mode, where it replaces the navigation bar so the taskbar is always there

Free features include showing up to 3 open apps, pinning up to 3 favorites, switching between gesture or button based controls, mini launcher sorting, and dynamic color themes. There is also a support upgrade that unlocks unlimited open apps, unlimited pinned apps, a full launcher, and removes ads.

Who it is for
People who multitask a lot, anyone tired of the Recents screen, users who like desktop-style workflows, and power users who want faster navigation.

The app uses the Accessibility Service permission only to show the taskbar over the navigation bar and to allow quick switching. No data is collected.

I have tried to add some nice animations to make it looks as native as possible, got lot of feature ideas but before that I would love to know from actual pro users on how they would want to use it!
